name: Liquid Reveal Cursor
description: A liquid cursor for React that opens a window onto a dark version of the page beneath. Its trail melts together like ink, swirls and breaks into drops, gathers back when you stop, wraps links and buttons, and splashes on click. One component, no dependencies; works on any page.

props.name: children
props.description: What the blob reveals: a gradient, an image, a second version of your design. Without it the blob shows the page itself through filter and tint.

props.name: size
props.description: Blob radius at rest, in px.

props.name: trail
props.description: How long the trail lives, in seconds.

props.name: smear
props.description: How far the trail keeps sliding after the pointer, from 0 to 1.

props.name: flow
props.description: How much the trail swirls, swells and breaks into drops, from 0 to 1.

props.name: speed
props.description: How much speed swells and stretches the blob, from 0 to 1.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds the pointer must rest before the trail gathers back into the head.

props.name: splash
props.description: Press for a splash of drops; hold to open the window wider.

props.name: lens
props.description: Over links, buttons and anything with data-cursor-lens, the blob melts into a rounded box around them.

props.name: filter
props.description: CSS filter for the page seen inside the blob. The default turns a light page dark while keeping its hues. Try 'grayscale(1)' or 'blur(6px)'.

props.name: tint
props.description: Colour laid over the revealed page with a lighten blend, so dark areas take this colour. 'transparent' for none.

props.name: grain
props.description: A fine film grain inside the blob.

props.name: hideCursor
props.description: Hide the native cursor so only the blob shows.

props.name: fixed
props.description: Follow the pointer over the whole page. false keeps it inside its parent (give the parent position: relative). In that case avoid overflow: hidden together with border-radius on an ancestor: Chrome then stops clipping the backdrop and the blob shows as a box.

props.name: zIndex
props.description: Stacking order of the cursor layers.
